code:
REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING
  A required field was blank.
  Fix: populate it, or make it optional.

DUPLICATE_VALUE
  A Unique field already has that value.
  Fix: this row probably needed upsert, not insert.
caption: DUPLICATE_VALUE is a field-level constraint, not a Chapter 3 Duplicate Rule.

code:
INVALID_CROSS_REFERENCE_KEY
  A lookup pointed at an Id that doesn't exist.
  Fix: load the parent first, or correct the key.

FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION
  A validation rule blocked the save.
  Fix: read the rest of the line - it's your own
  rule's Error Message, telling you what to change.
caption: The validation rule error always tells you exactly what it wants fixed.

code:
DUPLICATE_VALUE
  -- hard constraint on a Unique field
  -- fires on insert, every time

DUPLICATE_DETECTED
  -- a Duplicate Rule (Chapter 3) set to Block
  -- shows YOUR rule's own Alert Text
caption: Same word, two unrelated mechanisms — easy to mix up under deadline.
